head: 3e9d7ff
note: Posted on #33 as high. postMinSeverity() validates and throws a named error.

finding.summary: The default value for POST_MIN_SEVERITY is set to high, but the function does not validate that it is one of the allowed values (high, medium, or low).
finding.why_it_breaks: If a typo in the environment variable sets an invalid value, the application will fail at boot without any error message.
finding.suggested_fix: Add validation to ensure that POST_MIN_SEVERITY is one of the allowed values.

head: 3e9d7ff

finding.summary: The publicationNote function does not correctly handle cases where the minimum severity is set to low.
finding.why_it_breaks: If a PR has findings below the posting bar, they will be incorrectly marked as stored in the Check Run.
finding.suggested_fix: Ensure that the summary correctly reflects which findings are posted and which are stored.

head: 3e9d7ff

finding.summary: The ReviewPublisher class does not correctly handle the case where no findings are posted due to the severity gate.
finding.why_it_breaks: If a PR has only low-severity findings, the Check Run will incorrectly indicate that some findings were posted.
finding.suggested_fix: Ensure that the publication object correctly reflects whether any findings were posted.
